cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. True. Who was keeping that one warm from the inside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still on the cup. Did its owner take sugar?

mechanism: A confidently runs leaving-party catering but preserves the organiser cooperation by asking only decoration details that could identify the hidden guest.
confusable: Direct interrogation differs because A never asks the name, only circumstantial information usable for the supposed catering task.
comparison: The second alternative investigates a visitor through domestic arrangements rather than a secret workplace celebration.
seedUse: The cup seed supplies circumstantial inquiry, but the setting changes to cake decoration so S02 managerial help and the hidden-fact pursuit coexist.
